title: THE THIRD DAY HE ROSE AGAINE FROM THE DEAD.

segments.text: I Beleeue that Chriſt ſhooke off death from himſelfe, quickened his deade body, reunited his bodie vnto his ſoule, reſtored vnto himſelfe a bleſſed, celeſtial, and glorious life, and that by his owne proper power.

The chiefe Queſtions of chriſts reſurrection are,
1 Whether Chriſt roſe againe.
2 How he roſe.
3 For what cauſe he roſe.
4 The fruit of his reſurrection.
